## LANDED — all three changes merged, 1251 / 1252 / 1253

Each got LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, and the
stack was submitted from its top (1253), which submitted its ancestors. Confirmed
against gerrit main rather than the GitHub mirror (which lags):

    997e294967  5200: add the three parent cells (rows 12-13)
    3cae3660e0  5200: add outbound unassign and delete cells
    505ee29136  5200: split link add/remove into own cells

All seven new test functions are present in the landed file, which is 1786 lines.
The worktree is advanced onto the merged tip and the rebar-ticket commit is
reachable from HEAD.

Local suite as a second net beyond CI: tests/unit is 7153 passed / 21 skipped / 0
failures on the landed content.

### One self-caught defect worth recording, because it is this epic's own failure class

The first draft of the parent cells' wait helper took a predicate over
mapping[key], i.e. over the LOOKED-UP VALUE. get_parent_map has a degradation
contract: any REST failure logs a warning and returns {} (transport.py:520-527).
So "no parent for this key" and "the parent-map read failed entirely" were
indistinguishable, and the clear-parent wait would have been satisfied by a broken
read — the oracle would then have run against nothing and the cell could have
passed vacuously. Fixed before the change landed: the predicate now takes the
WHOLE map and the absence caller requires the key to be PRESENT with a falsy
value (lambda m: key in m and not m[key]). The reasoning is recorded in the
helper's docstring so the next author does not re-introduce it.

### Still open, and NOT to be closed by this story

The three product bugs this work proved are open and expected to make their cells
RED on the next harness run. That is the intended state — the cells assert the
AC's oracles, not the current behaviour:

- [rebar:751e-06f1-bb0b-464c] DC outbound clear-assignee never unassigns
- [rebar:2b16-9be0-a8f5-41d9] inbound link removal is never mirrored
- [rebar:88d9-fe42-e50f-4067] inbound parent clear is never emitted

Two cells additionally carry a PLATFORM unknown that only the harness can settle:
whether Data Center accepts nulling a sub-task's fields.parent. Both row-13 cells
report that outcome as SETUP FAILED with an explicit message rather than as a
bridge defect, so the first red will name which of the two it is.
